data.short_meaning: God is my father; my father is God
data.long_meaning: Abiel (אֲבִיאֵל) is a name of Hebrew origin meaning “God is my father; my father is God”. A theophoric compound of Hebrew אָב ('av) 'father' (with possessive yod) and אֵל (ʾel) 'God' - 'God is my father'. Its root is Hebrew אֲבִיאֵל (ʾAviʾel), from אָב ('av) 'father' + אֵל (ʾel) 'God'. Abiel is the anglicised form of Biblical Hebrew ʾAviʾel.

faq.q: What is the etymology of Abiel?
faq.a: A theophoric compound of Hebrew אָב ('av) 'father' (with possessive yod) and אֵל (ʾel) 'God' - 'God is my father'.

faq.q: Does Abiel appear in the Bible?
faq.a: Yes. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible (1 Samuel 9:1; 14:51).

faq.q: Is Abiel a Biblical name?
faq.a: Yes — the personal name occurs in the Biblical text. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible (1 Samuel 9:1; 14:51).

faq.q: Does Abiel occur in the Old Testament?
faq.a: Yes.

faq.q: Does Abiel occur in the New Testament?
faq.a: No — it is not attested in the New Testament.

faq.q: Is Abiel associated with a saint?
faq.a: No saint association is verified for the name Abiel.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Abiel verified?
faq.a: The meaning “God is my father; my father is God” is supported by Old Testament: father of Kish and Ner, grandfather of Saul (1 Samuel 9:1). Confidence: HIGH.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Abiel?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abiel total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is traditionally associated with cooperation, balance and sensitivity. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Abiel?
faq.a: Variants and alternative forms include Avi'el, Abiel.

faq.q: What is the transliteration of Abiel?
faq.a: Abiel is transliterated as ʾAviʾel.

faq.q: How many syllables does Abiel have?
faq.a: Abiel has 2 syllables.

faq.q: What are the spiritual connotations of Abiel?
faq.a: Any spiritual significance attached to Abiel is interpretive. Its documented core is the lexical meaning “God is my father; my father is God”, and readings built on that meaning are presented as tradition rather than as religious doctrine.

faq.q: Where is the name Abiel used today?
faq.a: Abiel circulates chiefly in Biblical Hebrew, English, Greek, Latin naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
